subject: 0605 (version 1999, file dated 09.02.2022) page 1 item 9, the fourth (branch-code) group of the 'Taxpayer Identification No.' comb chain: the printed box x 183.00-223.92, y 246.12-265.08 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source 0605version1999_09.02.2022_copy.pdf sha256 de04419766c59bf27fdeb854c0f7c3f98601900caa20630442e671e2313e536f. BIR's own field key for it is frm0605:txtBranchCode. The cell id p1c29 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch.
what: The branch-code comb carries five compartments instead of three, inside the SAME emitted box. Nothing is widened, moved or repainted: the box stays 40.91 x 18.96pt at 183,246.12, the writing surface stays top 0.75pt / height 17.46pt, and the five compartments divide the box equally -- left(i) = round(i * 40.91 / 5, 2) giving boundaries 0 / 8.18 / 16.36 / 24.55 / 32.73 / 40.91pt, a division that sums to exactly 40.91pt. The emitted writing surfaces keep the first/last insets the consumed batch already uses (first slot starts at 0.38pt, last slot ends at 40.54pt, i.e. a 0.37pt right inset), so the five slot boxes are left 0.38 / 8.18 / 16.36 / 24.55 / 32.73pt with widths 7.8 / 8.18 / 8.19 / 8.18 / 7.81pt summing to 40.16pt -- exactly as the batch's three slots sum to 40.16pt today (13.78 + 14.16 + 12.22). No 0pt-inset slot is restored. Each compartment carries one text input, maxlength 1, sharing the group's field name, slot indexes 0..4 contiguous. Declared pitch attribute 8.18 (nominal 40.91/5 = 8.182).
reason: BIR's 1999 artwork for 0605 is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. Measured from the pinned PDF, the branch box prints exactly two internal ticks, at x 197.16 and x 211.32, each 3.00pt tall at the foot of the box and stroked 0.75pt wide with butt caps -- three compartments, of printed widths 14.16 / 14.16 / 12.60pt. Unlike 2550M, this box carries NO pre-printed ink at all: no glyph, no bezier '000', nothing between the walls but the two ticks. BIR's own eBIRForms client, whose runtime this repository has harvested, declares that same field with max_length 5. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 1999' from 1999 ink, which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug. Filing safety: a branch code is what tells the Bureau WHICH establishment a payment form belongs to. 0605 is the payment form -- it is how a taxpayer remits a deficiency, a penalty, a registration fee or any assessed amount -- so a filer whose branch code has four or five digits cannot enter it at all and the payment is credited to branch 000, the head office, while the branch that owes the amount shows nothing paid. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3 (2550M, 2551M 2002, 2553 1999), one prints 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten are not measurable by that method. 0605-1999 is one of those ten, and this record measures it by hand as a fourth 3+3+3+3 bundle -- the census pin is NOT edited to say so, because it records what that method measured. 0605 is not the only form in this class; it is the one corrected here, and the others each need their own record.
authority: BIR eBIRForms HTA runtime declaration (harvested), regulation not identified in-repo. rules/forms/0605-v2003/fields.json declares field_key frm0605:txtBranchCode with constraints.max_length = 5, item_number "9", page 1, confidence "high", source_refs ["xml-encrypted-a#decrypted-field:frm0605:txtBranchCode", "xml-encrypted-b#decrypted-field:frm0605:txtBranchCode", "official-hta-runtime#control:L467"]; the same file declares frm0605:txtTIN1 / txtTIN2 / txtTIN3 with max_length 3 each, item_number "9" (official-hta-runtime#control:L464 / L465 / L466), so the 3-3-3 part of the chain is agreed and only the branch code is not. A REVISION GAP is stated rather than hidden: the only harvested inventory for this form in this checkout is form_id 0605-v2003, revision 2003-09-01, while the pinned artwork is the 1999 version; there is no rules/forms/0605-v1999. The runtime is therefore a LATER revision of the same form declaring the field the 1999 sheet prints, which is the same shape of claim this record makes ('the artwork is out of date') but is a second thing a reviewer must accept, not one. NO BIR issuance is cited because none could be identified from anything in this checkout; that gap is stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number, and it stays visible until someone supplies the real one.
diverges_from: audit.py comb_slots_match_printed on the 0605 item-9 branch comb -- the corrected document emits five compartments where the pinned artwork prints three, and must keep being reported as an offender of that assertion (failure kind layout-printed-mismatch where the layout carries the change, invalid-emission where only the markup does). audit.py inputs_span_no_printed_divider must gain offenders on the same comb, because the five equal compartments break at box-relative x 8.18 / 16.36 / 24.55 / 32.73 while the printed ticks stand at box-relative x 14.16 and 28.32: tick +14.16 falls strictly inside compartment 1 (8.18-16.36) and tick +28.32 falls strictly inside compartment 3 (24.55-32.73), so exactly two corrected inputs contain a printed divider. Neither may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, and no tolerance moves for it.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the three printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace` and by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg`, both agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.01pt on the box 183.00-223.92 x 246.12-265.08 and the two ticks 197.16 / 211.32 spanning y 261.36-264.36), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together.
